title: RWB-S6-E5025: the masking rule set, the tape layout, the tape's storage reference, the PII service mapping and the six consumed contracts are given by no source and sit outside the plan's empty C row
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.2 (s12), R7.3 and R9; WP B2-S6-015 story line RWB-S6-E5025-APP (H, C, I, X, patterns, acs, tcs, reqs); FSD S6 Debt sale v3 A1.1, A1.4, A2.3 and Requirements served; TSD S6 Debt sale v2 T2, T3.1, T3.2, T4, T5.1, T5.2, T5.3, T6.1 and T-A; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DS-10 to R-DS-13; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-DBS-03; legacy RWB-E5-025
section: Metadata (Depends on (build), Contract dependencies, Patterns applied); Sections 2, 3, 4, 11, 12.1, 12.2, 12.7, 12.8, 13, 15, 18 and 19
description: (1) No source fixes the content of the PII masking rule set, the tape column list, the tape file format or the tape spec version; the FSD says only 'personal data masked under PDPA' and 'the PII masking rules' and the legacy criteria repeat the phrase, so no masking pattern and no tape field can be copied and none is invented. (2) The FSD names a 'PII service' as an integration point and in the Systems column of R-DS-10 and R-DS-11, and the target's 19 services contain no such row; its two duties are left to the versioned rule set and to a check inside this service. (3) No table or column of rwb_debtsale carries a tape reference: the Ownership Map gives S6 two tables (debt_sale_lot, debt_sale_account) and neither has a document, tape or tape-status column, so the tape reference, checksum and masking-check result are held in the decision record and on the rwb-document metadata. (4) The plan gives H = RWB-PLT-E1027-CON and RWB-PLT-N001-CON with C, I and X empty, while the step reads the account and borrower facts of rwb-source-data, writes the file of rwb-document, reads the case state and reference data of rwb-case and reads the package of rwb-decision, so six consumed rows exist in fact and none in the metadata. (5) The plan's pattern set is DP03 and DP19, so DP-07 (reference data, H RWB-PLT-E1043-CON; C RWB-P3-E1043-CON) and DP-05 are absent although the step reads a versioned rule set and the ACE-fed personal facts. (6) No source publishes the operation names of the source-data read, the document write, the case-move answer, the reference-data read or the package read. (7) The plan and the legacy story carry no requirement id; REQ-S6-003 is read from the FSD Requirements served table. (8) FEAT-RDF-15, the legacy prerequisite, is named in no document of this WP's read set.
evidence: WP B2-S6-015 story line RWB-S6-E5025-APP with H of two platform CON stories and empty C, I, X and reqs; Template and Rules v1 R5.5 rows DP-03, DP-05, DP-07 and DP-19; FSD S6 A2.3.1 'Builds the data tape with personal data masked under PDPA', A2.3.2 'Integration points. ACE database, PII service', A2.3.3.1 row R-DS-10 and BR-S6-003, A2.3.3.3 'None; runs unattended', Requirements served row REQ-S6-003; TSD S6 T3.1 (debt_sale_lot DF-SAL-020 to DF-SAL-030, debt_sale_account DF-SAL-031 to DF-SAL-037, no tape column), T3.2, T4 rows R-DS-10 to R-DS-13, T5.1 INT-25 'Debt buyers, Out, File through the data room, Per lot', T5.3 'LotAwarded Published' only, T6.1 and T-A.5; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DS-10 to R-DS-13 with the Systems column 'PII service, Recovery Data Store, Document Hub'; S6 context pack ownership rows (tables 2, REST operations 5, events 1, jobs 0, workflows 1); legacy RWB-E5-025 Endpoints 'None. The work runs as a service or a scheduled job inside the recovery module'
area: Masking rules, tape specification, tape storage reference, PII service mapping, dependency rows and requirement id
proposed: Keep the H, C, I and X rows exactly as the plan states them; read the masking rule set and the tape spec as versioned reference data rather than as code; carry the six consumed rows in 12.2 with the operation-name placeholder and their fakes in 12.8; hold the tape reference, checksum and check result in the decision record because no S6 column carries them; record the PII service as an unmapped component rather than a call; and trace REQ-S6-003 from the FSD, with the missing values stated in the story instead of invented
